ALL LITERAL COPY ENTRIES:
[
  {"text":"서로 다른 속도","kind":"text","fixed_newlines":false}
]

{
  "conditions": [
    "Print the supplied title once with intact readable Hangul; no other copy, logos, labels or watermarks.",
    "Each output is a separate single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3.",
    "All five must have a substantive content-grounded non-glyph visual concept. Type/whitespace-only or tiny ornament, backgroundtexture/gradient/wallpaper, or3Dlettering-alone loopholes are prohibited.",

  ],
  "styles":{"mode":"open","exact_request":"어떤 느낌으로 할지는 맡길게."},
  "ratios":["2:3","2:3","2:3","2:3","2:3"]

This invocation produces exactly ONE independent R7-D1-M1 poster, assigned portrait width:height 2:3.
COMMON COORDINATOR CONSTRAINTS:
[
  "Print the supplied title exactly once, with intact readable Hangul and the original word spacing. Line breaks may occur between whole words. The directions are internal guidance and must not be printed.",
  "No other copy, supporting text, labels, numbers, logos, series identifiers, style names or watermarks. Depicted clothing, objects and surfaces must be unbranded and free of incidental text.",
  "Each assigned maker produces only its own independent, single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3. No panels, contact sheets, poster mockups or borrowing another maker's generated image as a reference.",
  "The substantial non-glyph relation must remain recognizable with the title hidden and at reduced viewing size. Tiny ornament, wallpaper, background texture, gradients and 3D lettering alone do not satisfy it.",
  "Preserve the assigned relation and distinction while solving practical crop, proportion, palette, alignment and title placement independently. There is no shared title-object-footer layout or common allocation of image and copy area.",
  "Downstream native-tool production must request the maximum resolution supported by the current tool and model while preserving 2:3; verify the actual returned dimensions and readable copy after generation."
]

DESIGN SPEC — precise-object-edit of supplied own repair-1 poster. Exactly one finished flat opaque portrait width:height 2:3 poster.
요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력

Image 1 is this role's own immediately preceding returned repair-1 poster. It has been inspected. Correct ONLY the concrete material finish that became repetitive during the previous title repair. Across the large visible pavement, especially the foreground below and around the title, remove the densely repeated small worm-like curls, rings and pseudo-swirled etching. Replace that accidental repetitive pattern with a credible dry, cast concrete surface: restrained irregular fine aggregate and small nonrepeating granular imperfections of varying low contrast, much less dense and less sharply etched than currently. Keep gentle broad daylight variation. Concrete must read as a real continuous pedestrian surface, not procedural wallpaper, embossed noise, stone veins, stucco, plastic or airbrushed smoothness. Preserve every paving-joint position, perspective, natural shadow edge and environmental geometry. This is a local MATERIAL correction, never a new conceptual scene, new filter or collage.

Preserve the repaired typography EXACTLY: “서로 다른 속도” appears once, with all six Hangul syllables intact and precisely two original word spaces. Keep its current lower-middle location, apparent size, dark-charcoal color, medium weight, normal upright square syllable proportions, open counters, conventional spacing, crisp edges and one level horizontal baseline. It is a stationary 2D poster-typography observation point within the shared ground area, not perspective floor paint. Do not italicize, skew, rotate, foreshorten, warp, emboss or stretch it. Do not add quote marks, punctuation or any other text. Do not replace the clean text with a texture.

Preserve the observational photograph, fixed elevated viewpoint, continuous concourse, low wall, natural daylight direction and shadows. Keep the sharp still navy-clothed adult at left with visibly settled foot contact and recognizable full body; keep the rust-clothed adult at right passing left-to-right in the same moment with coherent sustained directional motion blur, visible full-body stride and both shoes. Preserve the skin/cloth/shoe material character without adding texture. Keep person scale, placement, hand occlusion, clothing colors, passer blur length and body mass. No body crop change; do not move the leading shoe farther toward the right boundary. The substantial stillness/passage relation must remain recognizable at thumbnail size without title interpretation.

Keep the title beside the passer's foot-level trajectory in the open shared ground, with continuous pavement below. No header, caption band, footer, frame, mockup, panel, decorative streaks, extra people or props. Depicted clothing, objects and surfaces remain unbranded and free of incidental text. No copy beyond the sole title, logos, labels, numbers, marks or watermarks. Output exactly one single completed opaque portrait 2:3 poster.
